channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: The Houthis may soon discover the limits of Saudi strategic patience
item.description: Saudi Arabia has so far ignored provocations to preserve regional stability. But it may soon be pushed into action.

item.title: Iranians struggle to get by amid US war and domestic woes
item.description: People are facing mounting pressures, including rising living costs, electricity cuts and bombarded infrastructure.

item.title: Steep rise in civilian casualties in Russia-Ukraine war, UN says
item.description: Increasing use of long-range missiles and drones against targets far from the front line is worsening the civilian toll.

item.title: Israel has ‘no interest’ in joining US war on Iran, says Smotrich
item.description: Israeli Finance Minister says Israel has "no interest" in joining the renewed US military campaign against Iran.

item.title: Saudi Arabia slams Houthi blockade: How will rest of the world be impacted?
item.description: Saudi Arabia has condemned the Houthi naval blockade that could impact oil flow to importers of Saudi oil.

item.title: ASEAN diplomats voice ‘serious concern’ over Iran war and energy crisis
item.description: Southeast Asian countries are highly affected by oil supply shortages caused by Iran war and Strait of Hormuz closure.

item.title: Lebanese army says troops deploying in 'pilot zone' after Israeli withdrawal
item.description: A US-brokered agreement should see Israeli troops pulling out of a small part of Lebanon occupied during their conflict with Hezbollah.

item.title: US launches fresh strikes on Iran, as Trump warns of retaliation for deaths of soldiers
item.description: Iran says it has hit two ships in the Strait of Hormuz as well as targets in Bahrain and Jordan.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Gaza kill 12, including family of six, medics say
item.description: Firas al-Masri, his wife and their four children died in one attack, which the Israeli military says targeted a Hamas operative.

item.title: Yemen's Houthis announce 'maritime embargo' on Saudi Arabia
item.description: The Houthis say the embargo begins immediately and is a response to a Saudi blockade of ports and airports in Yemen.
